body_markdown:
***Contract for APS 2300 APU supports independent subsidiary of TAP Air Portugal***


**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. –** **November 23, 2026 –** **** StandardAero (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) and engine component repair, has signed a new multi-year contract with[Portugália Airlines](https://www.flytap.com/) to provide MRO services for the airline’s[Pratt & Whitney Canada APS 2300](https://standardaero.com/engines/prattwhitneycanada/aps2300/) auxiliary power units (APUs). Based in Lisbon, Portugal and operating under the TAP Express banner, Portugália Airlines, the regional airline of TAP’s Group, operates flights to destinations across Portugal and Europe.


Under the agreement, StandardAero will provide MRO services for the APS 2300 APUs equipping the fleet of 19 Embraer E190/195-E1 regional aircraft operated by Portugália Airlines. StandardAero’s Maryville, Tennessee location, which is an OEM-approved Authorized Repair Facility (ARF) for the APS 2300, will provide Portugália Airlines with a customized MRO program offering maximum support and flexibility to meet the airline’s specific operational needs.


Commenting on behalf of Portugália Airlines, Luiz Fernandes and Michael Nunes, of the engineering contract management team, shared the following perspective: “This agreement, supporting our strategy of maintaining a diversified and geographically balanced supplier network, represents an important step towards ensuring the long-term reliability and availability of our APS 2300 equipped fleet. As a regional carrier, Portugália Airlines places strong emphasis on operational performance, responsiveness, and cost-effective maintenance solutions. Through this agreement with StandardAero, we expect to benefit from responsive technical support, efficient maintenance services and predictable turnaround times over the coming years.”


“StandardAero is thrilled to extend our long-running relationship with Portugália Airlines and TAP Air Portugal through this new contract,” commented Tayeb Bouhassis, Director of Sales – Europe, Middle East & Africa for StandardAero. “As a longstanding provider of APS 2300 MRO services to Portugália Airlines, we know how important safety, operational excellence and sustainability are to the carrier, these priorities aligning closely with StandardAero’s own values. We look forward to continuing to provide Portugália Airlines and TAP Air Portugal with responsive, reliable APU services for many years to come.”


StandardAero was the first independent service provider for the APS 2300 APU, and believes its OEM-trained technicians provide customers with the most comprehensive, experienced and approved service in the industry. As an Authorized Repair Facility, StandardAero offers numerous benefits to APS 2300 operators, including full access to OEM technical support and documentation, full OEM warranty processing, full access to rental bank assets, component repair and LRU capabilities, and coordinated repair development with OEM authorization.


StandardAero’s 154,000 sq. ft. Maryville facility supports a wide range of APUs, including the Pratt & Whitney Canada APS 2300 (Embraer E170/175/190/195-E1), the Honeywell RE220 (CRJ700/900 family), Honeywell GTCP 36-100/150 (MHIRJ CR200 and others), and the Safran Power Units SPU300 (Bombardier Global 7500 & 8000). In addition to servicing a range of APUs, StandardAero’s Maryville facility is also a Rolls-Royce Authorized Maintenance Center (AMC) for the AE 2100 turboprop, AE 3007 turbofan and AE 1107 turboshaft, in addition to supporting the related MT7 marine gas turbine.


Founded in 1988 and commencing operations in 1990, Portugália Airlines has been part of the TAP Group since 2007. In 2016, the company renewed its fleet with a combination of Embraer E190 and E195 aircraft, giving the airline increased capacity and flexibility, while maintaining the same award-winning quality of service provided to passengers. Portugália Airlines now operates under the TAP Express brand. For more, please visit[www.flytap.com](http://www.flytap.com/) .


###


**StandardAero** is a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft, serving the commercial, military and business aviation end markets. StandardAero provides a comprehensive suite of critical, value-added aftermarket solutions, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul, engine component repair, on-wing and field service support, asset management and engineering solutions. StandardAero is an NYSE-listed company under the ticker symbol SARO.
